name: Make watershed BEM
summary: Computes watershed BEM surfaces (inner skull, outer skull, scalp) from a FreeSurfer reconstruction with MNE-Python make_watershed_bem, for MEG/EEG forward modelling.
description: Copies the FreeSurfer subject directory, runs mne.bem.make_watershed_bem (which wraps FreeSurfer's watershed algorithm) to add the BEM surfaces, and builds an HTML QC report of the surfaces over the MRI. Use it before computing a BEM solution and forward model for source localisation. Needs a completed recon-all directory and a FreeSurfer license.

outputs.description: Copy of the FreeSurfer subject directory with the watershed BEM surface files added.

citations.text: Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7(267):1-13 (2013).
